tasks.title: Add PDF parser for Mercado Pago credit-card faturas
tasks.justification: The Mercado Pago credit-card account has no working import path: its Google Drive folder had no .account file, and even with one there's no parser for its PDF fatura format. Design confirmed with the user (payment-of-previous-cycle line imports as a credit categorized 'Cartão de Crédito > Pagamento'; installment lines get a normalized ' PARC N/M' suffix so the existing installment detector picks them up; due date and total are extracted via the shared PDF statement-meta regexes, extended to also recognize the 'Total a pagar' label). Next: write the design spec doc, then the implementation plan, then implement via subagent-driven-development.
